items.html: And these were given, half of them to the right side in the Yesod of Aba, and half of them to the left in the Yesod of Ima. And then descended the drop of Mayin Dechurin (male waters), which are three Malchuts from the three right edges of the new MaH, and they joined together and were all given within Ima. And she also gave the drop of Mayin Nukvin (feminine waters), which are the three Malchuts of the three left edges of the new MaH. And then they were corrected within her, and were absorbed in the three days of absorption (Klitah).
